supabaseUrl.label: Supabase project URL
supabaseUrl.helpText: https://YOUR_PROJECT.supabase.co. Used to call the resolve-doi edge function and to write bot logs to the bot_logs table.

supabaseServiceKey.label: Supabase service key
supabaseServiceKey.helpText: Service key for writing bot logs to the bot_logs table, and the fallback bearer for resolve-doi when the function token is blank. Keep secret.

supabaseFunctionToken.label: Supabase function token
supabaseFunctionToken.helpText: Bearer token for the resolve-doi edge function (its SHA-256 is stored in function_tokens). Falls back to the service key when blank. Keep secret.

botSignature.label: General — Bot signature
botSignature.helpText: Appended to all bot comments. Leave blank for no signature.
botSignature.defaultValue: I am a bot. This action was performed automatically. Contact the moderators if you have questions.

predatoryWatchEnabled.label: Enable
predatoryWatchEnabled.helpText: Warn when a post or comment links a domain on the predatory/hijacked journal watchlist. Nothing is removed or reported.

predatoryWatchCheckComments.label: Check comments
predatoryWatchCheckComments.helpText: Also check new comments. A publisher already warned on that post is not warned again.

predatoryWatchWarning.label: Warning comment
predatoryWatchWarning.helpText: Posted when a watchlisted publisher is linked. Placeholders: {publisher}, {source_list} (or {source list}), {source_url}. Leave blank to post nothing. The bot signature is appended.
predatoryWatchWarning.defaultValue: Note that {publisher} appears on [{source_list}]({source_url}) as a possible [predatory journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predatory_publishing).

predatoryWatchAllowlist.label: Allowlist
predatoryWatchAllowlist.helpText: Domains or publisher names that never produce a warning, separated by commas or new lines. Default includes MDPI and Frontiers. Clear the field to stop exempting anyone.

predatoryWatchMatchPublisherName.label: Match publisher names
predatoryWatchMatchPublisherName.helpText: Weak secondary check: compare a DOI's publisher name to watchlist names when the landing domain did not match. Off by default. ISSN is never used.
